One way to get out should be to disable javascript when you notice the
looping process. Then as you close the pop-ups, the new ones (popped-up
by the still-running javsacript from the old ones) won't have the
javascript executed and eventually will become extinct as you continue
closing them. Then you can turn javascript back on.
